ledger_authority.permission: ADDENDA-07 permits pilot row preparation before full-ledger freeze; this row grants no feature acceptance or broad fan-out.

operation.entry: At the current parse-that UTF-16 offset, consume one maximal CSS number prefix and return one semantic leaf.
operation.maximality: Dot and exponent syntax are consumed only when their following ASCII-digit guards are complete.

result.type: Readonly<{ value: number; type: 'integer' | 'number'; sign: '+' | '-' | null }>
result.value: ECMAScript binary64 Number(exact consumed representation), compared with Object.is including negative zero, signed infinity, and underflow.
result.number_type: integer iff neither fraction nor exponent is consumed; otherwise number.
result.object_shape: Ordinary Object.prototype and exactly three own writable/enumerable/configurable string data properties value/type/sign; no symbols, accessors, surplus keys, raw, parts, or spans.

operation.source_observation: The harness observes source.slice(entryOffset, finalOffset) in the same input's UTF-16 code units; raw/preprocessed source mapping remains SYNTAX-SOURCE-MAP work.
operation.subordinate_number_start: The six §4.3.10 true arms are subordinate public branch fixtures only. SYNTAX-NUMBER-START is not a dependency, exported parser, or acceptance prerequisite.
excluded: tokens, atoms, component values, CST, lexer, scanner, cursor, or source-slicing runtime
percentage/dimension dispatch, identifier conformance, contextual bounds, math, EOF diagnostics, source mapping, serialization, and computed values

failure_contract.common: Return the same ParserState; set isError=true; preserve src identity/ownership; preserve entry offset; preserve predecessor value by Object.is; do not throw; preserve global diagnostics mode.
failure_contract.ordinary_diagnostics_disabled: Set furthest to the failed entry offset; expected remains undefined; preserve the same empty suggestions and secondarySpans array references and contents.
failure_contract.ordinary_diagnostics_enabled: Set furthest to the failed entry offset; expected is a nonempty array of nonempty strings; preserve the same empty suggestions and secondarySpans array references and contents.
failure_contract.preseeded_ahead_both_modes: When furthest is seeded beyond all candidate activity, preserve furthest, expected ownership/reference/content, suggestions reference/content, and secondarySpans reference/content exactly.
failure_contract.public_test: harness.ts applies every public failure to diagnostics disabled/enabled × ordinary/preseeded-ahead and all seven predecessor classes.

work_limit.complexity: O(n) time in the consumed prefix length and O(1) runtime stack for the finite static parser graph.
work_limit.construction_floor: Candidate topology permits only finite direct combinator construction and forbids lazy/recursive/local-function graphs, loops, manual state/source access, and source slicing.
work_limit.executable_scaling: For digits, fraction, exponent, and incomplete-exponent constructions at 4096/8192/16384/32768 code units, five-sample medians at each exact doubling use a 0.05 ms floor and every adjacent ratio must be <= 8; every invocation must complete semantically within 1000 ms.
work_limit.credit: A scaling PASS is a hostile rail, not benchmark or acceptance credit.

retained_public_cases.role: unchanged semantic, subordinate start-arm, composition, malformed, offset, and hostile evidence

oracle_roles.spec: Pinned CSS Syntax §4.3.13 exact occurrence is normative.
oracle_roles.live: Retiring LIVE regex participates only on a declared semantics-equivalent common-domain lane.
oracle_roles.browser: Browser observation may classify numeric literal behavior but cannot override the pinned algorithm or this internal prefix boundary.
oracle_roles.bbnf: Acknowledged value-unit.bbnf is construction/provenance evidence; its f64 projection and unit dispatch are outside this row.

benchmark_door: Allocate ParserState(source, predecessor, offset), invoke the exact admitted consumeNumber once with diagnostics disabled, and fold isError/offset/value/type/sign plus same-input consumed-extent identity after public and revealed-holdout semantic PASS.

owner_review_law.selection: Five unblocked skeptic receipts and three pairwise-independent unanimous adjudicators must bind one exact already-reviewed candidate hash.

credit: ZERO: prepared pilot row and executable precursor only.
